## Change request

<!-- e.g. CR-DIDAS-0003: Short title -->

Discussion issue: #

Steward:

Type of pull request: new change request / status change / other

## New change request

Merged with the status *Draft* once the steward has confirmed it. Merging publishes it; it is not an endorsement.

- [ ] File named `proposals/CR-DIDAS-NNNN-short-title.md` with the next free number
- [ ] Front matter filled in, including aspects and sectors
- [ ] Problem described from the perspective of the actors affected
- [ ] Requested outcome stated at a high level
- [ ] Every statement about swiyu checked against the current specification or code and referenced with a commit-pinned link
- [ ] *Sources* table filled in
- [ ] Facts, assessments and open questions kept apart
- [ ] Row added to `proposals/README.md` and a file to `changelog/`
- [ ] Relevant interests disclosed
- [ ] Steward confirms the change request is ready for publication

## Status change

Tick the gate that applies. See GOVERNANCE.md.

- [ ] To *In consultation*: working groups of the affected sectors named in the *Governance* table and notified
- [ ] To *Awaiting council*: at least 14 days of consultation, a position from every consulted working group, *Community input* written including dissent
- [ ] To *Endorsed*: council decisions recorded with date and link; for several sectors, positions consolidated by DIDAS and any escalation to the Steering Circle recorded; sources re-checked against the current specification
- [ ] To *Submitted*, *Accepted*, *Implemented*, *Declined* or *Withdrawn*: link to the submission or the swiyu response, or the reason
- [ ] Status updated in the change request, the index and the changelog
